theme.designMd:
# Roam travel booking app (code.in.30s)
Destination explorer + booking mobile app. Soft glassmorphism + clean minimal: frosted translucent pills over photos (backdrop blur, white 20-30% fill, thin white border), 20px radius cards, full-round pill chips and search, soft diffuse shadows, Plus Jakarta Sans, thin rounded line icons, real travel photography (mountains, beaches, lakes, old towns). NO emoji, NO serif fonts, NO illustrations.
## Dark: deep teal-navy background #0F1E2E with a subtle #17324A wash at the top, cards/surfaces #1A2B3E with 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border, ink #F2F6FB, secondary #8A9BB0. Same azure accent gradient #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF for active chip, CTA and active nav. Frosted pills over photos stay translucent. Coral #E8573A heart, gold #F5B223 stars. No neon glow.

screens.prompt:
Create the mobile HOME screen for the travel booking / destination explorer app "Roam".

Device viewport: 390x844 mobile app.
Color Palette & Aesthetic:
- Dark mode in deep teal-navy: Canvas background #0F1E2E with a subtle #17324A gradient wash at the top. Surfaces / cards #1A2B3E with subtle 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.08).
- Primary ink: #F2F6FB, Secondary muted ink: #8A9BB0.
- Accent: Azure gradient from #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF for active chips, primary highlights, and active navigation.
- Accent items: Coral #E8573A heart icon, Gold #F5B223 star rating.
- No neon glows, clean minimal modern aesthetic.
- Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans (clean rounded geometric sans-serif, NO serif fonts).
- Glassmorphism: Frosted translucent glass pills over photos with backdrop blur, white 20-25% fill (`bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/25`), crisp text.
- Thin rounded stroke line icons, NO emojis anywhere.

Screen Layout & Content:
1. Status Bar / Top Header:
   - Left: Small round traveler avatar photo (Aria) + text block next to it with "Hi, Aria" (font-semibold, text-[#F2F6FB]) and subtext "Where to next?" (text-xs text-[#8A9BB0]).
   - Right: Frosted glass location pill with location pin icon and text "Bali, Indonesia" (pill shape, subtle border).

2. Headline:
   - Big bold display title in 2 lines: "Explore the\nworld" (text-3xl font-bold text-[#F2F6FB] tracking-tight leading-tight).

3. Search Bar:
   - Full-round pill search bar container with search magnifying glass icon, placeholder text "Search destinations" in #8A9BB0, and on the far right a circular filter settings icon button with subtle border.

4. Category Filter Chips:
   - Horizontal scrolling row of pill chips:
     - "All" (Active: filled with azure gradient from #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF, text-white, font-medium, rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm shadow-sm).
     - "Popular" (Inactive: bg-[#1A2B3E] text-[#8A9BB0] border border-white/10 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm).
     - "Recommended" (Inactive: bg-[#1A2B3E] text-[#8A9BB0] border border-white/10 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm).
     - "Most visited" (Inactive: bg-[#1A2B3E] text-[#8A9BB0] border border-white/10 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm).

5. Featured Destinations Section:
   - Horizontal row showing 2 TALL vertical destination cards (~200px width by ~280px height, rounded-3xl / 20px radius, overflow-hidden relative shadow-lg):
     - Card 1: "Kyoto, Japan" with lush Japanese shrine / temple bamboo garden photography.
       - Top-left overlay: Frosted glass pill (`bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/30 text-white rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold`) with gold #F5B223 star icon and "4.8".
       - Top-right overlay: Frosted glass circular heart button (`bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/30 rounded-full p-2 flex items-center justify-center`) with coral #E8573A heart icon.
       - Bottom overlay: Frosted glass panel or clean gradient overlay at bottom with "Kyoto" (font-bold text-base text-white), "Japan" (text-xs text-white/80 with location pin), and "$420" (text-sm font-bold text-white) + "/ person" (text-xs text-white/70).
     - Card 2: "Santorini, Greece" with vivid white cave houses and blue domes overlooking the Aegean sea.
       - Top-left overlay: Frosted glass rating pill with gold star and "4.9".
       - Top-right overlay: Frosted glass circular heart button.
       - Bottom overlay: "Santorini", "Greece", and "$540 / person".

6. "Popular trips" Section:
   - Section header with "Popular trips" (font-bold text-lg text-[#F2F6FB]) and "See all" link (text-sm text-[#3B8CF5] font-medium).
   - One compact list row card (bg-[#1A2B3E] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center gap-3.5):
     - Left: Rounded rectangular photo thumbnail (Lake Bled, Slovenia with island church).
     - Middle: Destination title "Lake Bled, Slovenia" (font-semibold text-sm text-[#F2F6FB]), trip duration "3 days" with clock/calendar icon (text-xs text-[#8A9BB0]), and rating with gold star "4.9".
     - Right: Price "$280" (font-bold text-base text-[#F2F6FB]) + "/ person" (text-xs text-[#8A9BB0]).

7. Bottom Navigation Bar:
   - Floating frosted pill navigation bar at bottom (`bg-[#1A2B3E]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/15 rounded-full mx-5 mb-4 py-2.5 px-4 shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-around`).
   - 4 items:
     - Home (Active: azure gradient icon indicator `#3B8CF5`, label "Home" text-xs text-white font-medium).
     - Explore (compass / search icon, label "Explore" text-xs text-[#8A9BB0]).
     - Trips (ticket / bookmark icon, label "Trips" text-xs text-[#8A9BB0]).
     - Profile (person icon, label "Profile" text-xs text-[#8A9BB0]).

Maintain clean hierarchy, generous touch targets, exact 390px mobile layout discipline with no horizontal page overflow.
screens.title: Roam - Home

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Roam** Home screen in deep teal-navy dark mode:

### Design Highlights:
- **Atmospheric Palette**: Deep teal-navy canvas (`#0F1E2E`) with a soft top wash (`#17324A`), paired with card surfaces (`#1A2B3E`) and subtle 1px translucent borders (`rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`).
- **Glassmorphic Overlays**: Frosted translucent pills (`backdrop-blur`, white ~25% tint with hairline white borders) applied cleanly over rich destination photography for star ratings (gold `#F5B223`), favorite actions (coral `#E8573A`), and bottom destination pricing panels.
- **Typography & Structure**: Geometric Plus Jakarta Sans font hierarchy with a prominent 2-line "Explore the world" display title, rounded pill search bar, and filter options.
- **Interactive Controls**: Active category pill and floating bottom navigation tab highlighted with Roam's signature azure blue gradient (`#3B8CF5` to `#5AA7FF`).
- **Destinations & Trips**: Showcases tall vertical photo cards for Kyoto and Santorini alongside a compact horizontal row card for Lake Bled.

screens.prompt:
Mobile travel booking / destination explorer app called "Roam".
Device viewport: 390x844 mobile app layout.
Theme: Deep teal-navy dark mode (background #0F1E2E with a subtle #17324A gradient wash at top, card surfaces #1A2B3E with 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.08), ink text #F2F6FB, secondary text #8A9BB0).
Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans everywhere (rounded geometric sans, no serif).
Accent colors: Azure accent gradient (#3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF), Coral #E8573A for favorite heart, Gold #F5B223 for rating star. No neon glow.
Glassmorphism: Frosted translucent glass pills over photos (backdrop-blur-md, white ~25% fill `bg-white/25`, thin border `border border-white/20`, text-white). Thin rounded line icons (Material Symbols Outlined). NO emoji.

Screen Layout & Sections:
1. Status bar area and Header:
   - Header title "Explore" (bold, font-headline, text-[#F2F6FB], text-2xl).
   - Trailing item: Round frosted bell notification icon button (w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#1A2B3E]/80 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-[#F2F6FB]).
2. Search bar:
   - Full-round pill search bar (`rounded-full bg-[#1A2B3E] border border-white/10 px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3`).
   - Left search icon (`search` line icon in #8A9BB0).
   - Placeholder text: "Search places, hotels…" in #8A9BB0.
   - Right filter button: circular or pill button with filter/sliders icon (`tune` or `tune` icon) in subtle azure/white styling.
3. Category Chips Row:
   - Horizontal scrolling pills row:
     - "Beaches" (Active: azure gradient bg-gradient-to-r from-[#3B8CF5] to-[#5AA7FF] text-white shadow-sm font-semibold rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm).
     - "Mountains" (Inactive: rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm bg-[#1A2B3E] border border-white/10 text-[#8A9BB0] hover:text-[#F2F6FB]).
     - "Cities" (Inactive: rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm bg-[#1A2B3E] border border-white/10 text-[#8A9BB0] hover:text-[#F2F6FB]).
     - "Lakes" (Inactive: rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm bg-[#1A2B3E] border border-white/10 text-[#8A9BB0] hover:text-[#F2F6FB]).
4. Big Featured Photo Card:
   - Full width card (~350px wide, ~330px high, 24px border radius `rounded-3xl` overflow-hidden relative shadow-xl).
   - High quality photography of tropical turquoise lagoon Maldives overwater bungalows / crystal clear turquoise waters.
   - Top-left badge: Frosted glass pill (`bg-white/25 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/30 text-white text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1.5`) with "Trending" label and a small sparkle or flame icon.
   - Top-right button: Frosted glass circular button (`w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-white/25 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/30 flex items-center justify-center`) with a coral `#E8573A` filled or line heart icon.
   - Bottom frosted panel / pill overlay:
     - Wide frosted card container (`bg-[#0F1E2E]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/15 rounded-2xl p-4 m-3` or frosted glass bar):
       - Destination title: "Maafushi Island" (bold text-lg text-white), with location "Maldives" and a tiny pin icon.
       - Rating row: Gold `#F5B223` star icon, "4.9", and secondary text "(2.1k reviews)" in white/80.
       - Price & Action row: "$899" (bold text-xl text-white) + "/ person" in white/60, and on the right a small frosted circular arrow button (`w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-white/25 border border-white/30 flex items-center justify-center text-white` with `arrow_forward` icon).
5. "Nearby escapes" Section:
   - Section header: "Nearby escapes" (font-bold text-lg text-[#F2F6FB]) and "See all" text button in #5AA7FF.
   - 2-column grid of smaller destination cards:
     - Card 1: Swiss Alps photo (snowy alpine peaks, green valleys), rounded-2xl relative h-44 overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-[#1A2B3E]. Top-right frosted heart. Bottom frosted gradient with "Swiss Alps" title, location "Switzerland", and price "$640".
     - Card 2: Amalfi Coast photo (cliffside pastel village over Mediterranean blue sea), rounded-2xl relative h-44 overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-[#1A2B3E]. Top-right frosted heart. Bottom frosted gradient with "Amalfi Coast" title, location "Italy", and price "$720".
6. Floating Bottom Navigation Bar:
   - Uses predicted component BottomNavBar style:
   - Floating frosted pill bar (`fixed bottom-4 inset-x-5 max-w-sm mx-auto z-50 rounded-full bg-[#1A2B3E]/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl py-2 px-3 flex justify-around items-center`).
   - 4 destinations with icons & small labels:
     - Home (icon: `home`, label: "Home", inactive: text-[#8A9BB0])
     - Explore (icon: `explore`, label: "Explore", ACTIVE: pill highlight or text with azure gradient `#3B8CF5` to `#5AA7FF` / text-white with active background pill or azure icon)
     - Trips (icon: `luggage` or `confirmation_number`, label: "Trips", inactive: text-[#8A9BB0])
     - Profile (icon: `person`, label: "Profile", inactive: text-[#8A9BB0])
   - Sufficient bottom padding (pb-24) on the scrollable container so no content is blocked by the floating navigation bar.

screens.prompt:
Mobile travel booking / destination explorer app called "Roam".
Soft glassmorphism + clean minimal style in DARK mode.
Background: deep teal-navy #0F1E2E with a subtle #17324A gradient wash at top.
Surfaces/cards: #1A2B3E with 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.08).
Ink: #F2F6FB, secondary/muted text: #8A9BB0.
Azure accent gradient: #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF for primary CTA, active chips/accents.

No neon glow. Rounded pills, 20-28px radius cards, frosted glass pills over photos (backdrop-blur, white ~25% fill, border border-white/20) for rating and actions. Thin rounded line icons. NO emoji. Viewport fits 390x844 with airy spacing.

Screen: DESTINATION DETAIL
- Top hero: Large hero photo filling top ~45% showing Swiss alpine lake with mountains (Lake Brienz / turquoise water alpine landscape), with bottom corners rounded 28px (rounded-b-[28px]).
- Floating controls over hero:

  * Top-right: Frosted circular glass heart button (coral #E8573A heart icon).
  * Bottom-right of hero: Row of 3 small rounded thumbnail previews (scenic mountain lake views, boat tour, alpine chalet) overlaid inside frosted container with subtle active border.
- Destination Details Content below hero (dark teal-navy background #0F1E2E):
  * Header row: Destination title "Lake Brienz" in bold font-extrabold text-2xl text-[#F2F6FB].
  * Location row: Location "Interlaken, Switzerland" with location_on pin icon in azure #3B8CF5.
  * Meta info pills row: Gold star with "4.9" and "(1.2k reviews)" in a frosted dark pill, next to a soft pill "5 days" (with schedule/calendar icon).
  * Section "Top Facilities": Heading text in bold font-semibold text-base text-[#F2F6FB]. Horizontal row of 4 rounded-2xl tiles with dark/pale sky tinted glass surfaces (#1A2B3E/90 border border-white/10), each having a thin line icon and label:
    1. Wi-Fi (wifi icon, label "Wi-Fi")
    2. Dinner (restaurant / silver_plate icon, label "Dinner")
    3. Pool (pool / water icon, label "Pool")
    4. Hiking (hiking / terrain icon, label "Hiking")

Followed by inline or trailing azure text link "Read more" in #3B8CF5 font-semibold.
- Bottom Sticky Bar:

  * Left side: Price display with "$1,250" in bold text-2xl text-[#F2F6FB] and "/ person" in text-xs text-[#8A9BB0].

screens.title: Roam - Destination Detail

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Destination Detail** screen for **Lake Brienz** in Roam's dark mode palette:

### Design Details:
- **Hero Image (Top ~45%)**: An alpine lake view of Lake Brienz with bottom corners rounded at 28px. Features a frosted circular back button (top left), action buttons (share & favorite heart in top right), and thumbnail previews tucked into the bottom right corner.
- **Header & Meta**: Bold destination title **"Lake Brienz"**, location badge for **"Interlaken, Bernese Oberland, Switzerland"**, review rating pill with gold star (`4.9 (1.2k reviews)`), trip duration pill (`5 days / 4 nights`), and climate tag.
- **Top Facilities**: 4 rounded-square glassmorphism cards featuring clean thin line icons for **Wi-Fi**, **Dinner**, **Pool**, and **Hiking**.
- **Description & Highlights**: Crisp multi-line description with azure **"Read more"** toggle, plus trip highlight cards and cancellation reassurance tags.
- **Sticky Booking Bar**: Docked bottom action bar with transparent frosted blur, clear price display (**$1,250 / person**), and prominent azure gradient **"Book Now"** pill CTA. No bottom navigation bar, focusing the user directly on booking conversion.
